summary: Patched the Rerun logging regression so depth is no longer logged under the camera hierarchy, while preserving the world-frame camera frustum and projected RGB image plane. Restored ordinary 2D inspection streams under spear/images and updated the flashlight README plus running guide to describe the corrected paths.
work_completed: Changed Rerun camera logging to keep the world-frame Transform3D and Pinhole at spear/camera.
Kept the projected RGB camera child at spear/camera/rgb_projection for the 3D frustum/image-plane view.
Restored 2D image inspection streams at spear/images/rgb, spear/images/depth_meters, spear/images/world_normal_visualization, and spear/images/diffuse_color_visualization.
Ensured metric depth is logged only at spear/images/depth_meters as rr.DepthImage, outside spear/camera, so Rerun does not back-project it into a default 3D point cloud.
Preserved trajectory logging at spear/camera_position and spear/camera_trajectory.

Preserved flashlight direction and status logging at spear/light/direction, spear/light/intensity, spear/light/enabled, spear/light/yaw_offset_degrees, spear/light/pitch_offset_degrees, and spear/light/status.
Updated docs to match the corrected camera/frustum, projected RGB, 2D image, depth, trajectory, and status behavior.

Verified static search finds no rr.DepthImage logging under spear/camera and no stale spear/camera/depth_meters, spear/camera/world_normal_visualization, or spear/camera/diffuse_color_visualization references.
